"""Independent saved-week UI receiver; exact source on loopback, synthetic boot API only."""
import argparse, hashlib, json, mimetypes, os, platform, threading, traceback
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from http.server import BaseHTTPRequestHandler, ThreadingHTTPServer
from pathlib import Path
from urllib.parse import urlsplit
from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright

def now(): return datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
def identity(path):
    b=path.read_bytes()
    return {"bytes":len(b),"sha256":hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest(),"git_blob":hashlib.sha1(b"blob "+str(len(b)).encode()+b"\0"+b).hexdigest()}
def inventory(root): return {str(p.relative_to(root)):identity(p) for p in sorted(root.rglob("*")) if p.is_file()}
parser=argparse.ArgumentParser()
parser.add_argument("--root",type=Path,required=True)
parser.add_argument("--source",type=Path,required=True)
parser.add_argument("--output",type=Path,required=True)
args=parser.parse_args()
root=args.root.resolve(); source=args.source.resolve(); out=args.output
out.mkdir(mode=0o700)
acceptance=json.loads((root/"acceptance.json").read_text())
before=inventory(source)
record={"schema":1,"started_at":now(),"scope":acceptance["scope"],"base":acceptance["base"],
        "source":str(source),"source_before":before,"receiver":identity(Path(__file__)),
        "acceptance":identity(root/"acceptance.json"),"fixture_files":inventory(root/"fixtures"),
        "environment":{"python":platform.python_version(),"os":platform.platform(),
        "isolation":"private launcher HOME/XDG/TMP; environment isolation, not an OS sandbox",
        "chromium_sandbox":False},"cases":[],"server_requests":[]}
static={("/"+p):source/p for p in before}
static["/"]=source/"static/index.html"
class Handler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
    def log_message(self,*unused): pass
    def do_GET(self):
        path=urlsplit(self.path).path
        record["server_requests"].append({"method":"GET","path":path})
        if path=="/api/health": data=b'{"qloo_mode":"mock"}'; mime="application/json"
        elif path=="/api/personas": data=b"[]"; mime="application/json"
        elif path=="/favicon.ico": self.send_response(204);self.end_headers();return
        elif path in static:
            data=static[path].read_bytes()
            mime="text/javascript" if path.endswith((".js",".mjs")) else (mimetypes.guess_type(path)[0] or "text/html")
        else: self.send_error(404);return
        self.send_response(200); self.send_header("Content-Type",mime+"; charset=utf-8")
        self.send_header("Content-Length",str(len(data)));self.end_headers();self.wfile.write(data)
    def do_POST(self):
        record["server_requests"].append({"method":"POST","path":urlsplit(self.path).path})
        self.send_error(405)
server=ThreadingHTTPServer(("127.0.0.1",0),Handler)
origin="http://127.0.0.1:"+str(server.server_port)
thread=threading.Thread(target=server.serve_forever,daemon=True);thread.start()
record["origin"]=origin
def form(page):
    return page.locator("#form").evaluate("(f)=>({city:f.city.value,cuisines:f.cuisines.value,music:f.music.value,films:f.films.value,constraints:[...f.querySelectorAll('[name=constraints]:checked')].map(x=>x.value)})")
def open_file(page,name):
    with page.expect_file_chooser() as fc: page.locator("#openWeek").click()
    fc.value.set_files(root/"fixtures"/name)
    page.wait_for_function("document.querySelector('#form').getAttribute('aria-busy')==='false'")
    return page.locator("#requestStatus").inner_text()
def check(case,name,value,observed=None):
    case["checks"].append({"name":name,"pass":bool(value),"observed":observed})
try:
    with sync_playwright() as pw:
        browser=pw.chromium.launch(headless=True,chromium_sandbox=False)
        record["environment"]["browser"]=browser.version
        for spec in acceptance["cases"]:
            case={"id":spec["id"],"width":spec["width"],"checks":[],"requests":[],"external_requests":[],"errors":[],"assets":{}}
            record["cases"].append(case)
            context=browser.new_context(viewport={"width":spec["width"],"height":900},accept_downloads=True,service_workers="block")
            page=context.new_page();responses=[]
            def route_request(route):
                url=route.request.url
                if url.startswith(origin+"/"): route.continue_()
                else:
                    case["external_requests"].append(url);route.abort()
            context.route("**/*",route_request)
            page.on("request",lambda r:case["requests"].append({"method":r.method,"url":r.url}))
            page.on("pageerror",lambda e:case["errors"].append(str(e)))
            page.on("response",lambda r:responses.append(r))
            try:
                page.goto(origin+"/",wait_until="networkidle")
                page.wait_for_function("document.querySelector('#mode').textContent.startsWith('Demo mode:')")
                if not spec["valid"]:
                    status=open_file(page,spec["prior"])
                    prior=form(page)
                    check(case,acceptance["invalid_checks"][0],status.startswith("Saved week opened.") and page.locator("#results").is_visible(),status)
                status=open_file(page,spec["file"])
                case["status"]=status
                if spec["valid"]:
                    names=acceptance["valid_checks"]
                    check(case,names[0],status.startswith("Saved week opened.") and page.locator("#results").is_visible(),status)
                    disclosure=page.locator("details.original-evidence")
                    if disclosure.get_attribute("open") is None: disclosure.locator("summary").first.click()
                    rows=page.locator("#compare tr").evaluate_all("(rs)=>rs.slice(1).map(r=>[...r.querySelectorAll('td')].map(c=>c.textContent.trim()))")
                    case["table_rows"]=rows
                    check(case,names[1],[r[0] for r in rows]==acceptance["labels"],[r[0] for r in rows])
                    check(case,names[2],[r[1] for r in rows]==list(map(str,spec["grounded"])),[r[1] for r in rows])
                    check(case,names[3],[r[2] for r in rows]==list(map(str,spec["llm"])),[r[2] for r in rows])
                    provenance=page.locator("#savedWeekSource").inner_text()
                    check(case,names[4],spec["file"] in provenance and "have not been run again" in provenance,provenance)
                    with page.expect_download() as download_info: page.locator("#saveWeek").click()
                    download=download_info.value
                    download_path=out/(spec["id"]+"-resaved.json");download.save_as(download_path)
                    saved=json.loads(download_path.read_text()); original=json.loads((root/"fixtures"/spec["file"]).read_text())
                    case["download"]={"suggested_filename":download.suggested_filename,**identity(download_path)}
                    check(case,names[5],saved["response"]==original["response"])
                    check(case,names[6],saved["inputs"]==original["inputs"] and saved["week"]==original["week"])
                    check(case,names[7],saved["receivedAt"]==original["receivedAt"] and saved["calendarId"]==original["calendarId"])
                    if spec["id"].startswith("zero"):
                        picture=out/(spec["id"]+".png")
                        page.locator("#compare").screenshot(path=picture)
                        case["screenshot"]={"path":str(picture),**identity(picture)}
                    common=names[8:]
                else:
                    names=acceptance["invalid_checks"]
                    check(case,names[1],"invalid comparison counts" in status,status)
                    check(case,names[2],page.locator("#results").is_hidden())
                    check(case,names[3],page.locator("#saveWeek").is_disabled())
                    check(case,names[4],form(page)==prior,form(page))
                    common=names[5:]
                storage=page.evaluate("({local:Object.keys(localStorage),session:Object.keys(sessionStorage)})")
                check(case,common[0],not case["external_requests"],case["external_requests"])
                forbidden=[r for r in case["requests"] if r["method"]!="GET" or ("/api/" in r["url"] and urlsplit(r["url"]).path not in ["/api/health","/api/personas"])]
                check(case,common[1],not forbidden,forbidden)
                check(case,common[2],not case["errors"],case["errors"])
                check(case,common[3],not storage["local"] and not storage["session"],storage)
                for response in responses:
                    path=urlsplit(response.url).path
                    if path in static:
                        data=response.body()
                        relative=str(static[path].relative_to(source))
                        case["assets"][relative]={"bytes":len(data),"sha256":hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest(),"status":response.status}
                case["served_assets_exact"]=all(before[p]["bytes"]==v["bytes"] and before[p]["sha256"]==v["sha256"] and v["status"]==200 for p,v in case["assets"].items())
                case["app_js_loaded_exact"]=case["assets"].get("static/app.js",{}).get("sha256")==before["static/app.js"]["sha256"]
                case["pass"]=all(x["pass"] for x in case["checks"]) and case["served_assets_exact"] and case["app_js_loaded_exact"]
            except Exception:
                case["driver_error"]=traceback.format_exc();case["pass"]=False
            finally: context.close()
        browser.close()
except Exception: record["driver_error"]=traceback.format_exc()
finally:
    server.shutdown();server.server_close();thread.join(timeout=5)
    record["server_stopped"]=not thread.is_alive()
    record["source_after"]=inventory(source);record["source_preserved"]=record["source_after"]==before
    record["completed_at"]=now()
    record["summary"]={"cases":len(record["cases"]),"passed_cases":sum(c.get("pass",False) for c in record["cases"]),
      "checks":sum(len(c["checks"]) for c in record["cases"]),"passed_checks":sum(x["pass"] for c in record["cases"] for x in c["checks"])}
    record["pass"]=record["summary"]["passed_cases"]==len(acceptance["cases"]) and record["source_preserved"] and record["server_stopped"] and not record.get("driver_error")
    target=out/"browser-receipt.json";target.write_text(json.dumps(record,indent=2)+"\n")
    print(json.dumps({"receipt":str(target),"identity":identity(target),"summary":record["summary"],"pass":record["pass"],"driver_error":record.get("driver_error"),"cases":[{"id":c["id"],"pass":c.get("pass"),"failed":[x["name"] for x in c["checks"] if not x["pass"]],"driver_error":c.get("driver_error")} for c in record["cases"]]}))
raise SystemExit(0 if record["pass"] else 1)
